scenarios.title: Acoustic Tuning & Early VIP Arrival Conflict
scenarios.premise: VIP Guests commence arrival at 17:15. Primary Sound Check and wireless microphone line tests are scheduled for 17:00-17:45 in the main foyer.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Acoustic line tests (105dB pink noise) directly overlap with VIP red-carpet arrival window, creating acute guest discomfort and communications blackout.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Audio rigging calibration requires 35 minutes of uninterruptible acoustic sweep.
Axiom 2: VIP protocol dictates quiet, ambient welcome hospitality with zero high-decibel disturbance.
Deduction 3: Delaying sound check past 18:00 risks keynote microphone feedback during opening addresses.
Synthesis 4: Advancing AV testing to 15:45 clears the hall 90 minutes prior to doors, fully resolving the collision.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Mute line test and rely on software simulation (risks live acoustic feedback).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Advance crew call by 45 minutes to execute acoustic checks early.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Eliminates 100% of live performance failure risk while preserving dignified VIP welcome.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Advance AV Frequency & Acoustic Check to 15:45
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Sound check completed early; master readiness elevated to 94%.

scenarios.title: Ballroom Circulation Choke-Point vs Dance Floor
scenarios.premise: Grand Amber Palace provides 6,500 sq ft. At 450 guests plus a 700 sq ft dance floor and 8-station buffet, aisle widths contract to 3.2 ft.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Egress corridor width violates 5.0 ft municipal safety standard, risking a 14-minute dinner buffet queue bottleneck.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Spatial safety standards require minimum 5.0 ft clear egress corridors.
Axiom 2: 8 buffet stations occupy 1,200 sq ft perimeter queuing envelope.
Deduction 3: Converting to Synchronized Butler Plated Service reclaims 850 sq ft of floor plate.
Synthesis 4: Expanding perimeter walkway to 6.2 ft achieves optimal traffic circulation.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Reduce guest seating count by 40 guests (violates host invitation list).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Convert to Synchronized Butler Plated Service and compact AV rear-projection.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Reclaims 850 sq ft of open circulation without dropping a single invited guest.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Adopt Synchronized Plated Service Layout (+45% Aisle Width)
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Egress expanded to 6.2 ft; ballroom circulation certified 100% hazard-free.

scenarios.title: Cross-Allergen Proximity & Table 02 Seating Clash
scenarios.premise: Sophia Dubois (Anaphylactic Peanut/Tree Nut Allergy) and Ambassador Tariq (Halal dietary protocol) are seated at Table 02 adjacent to the primary pastry tray service corridor.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Pastry serving station features hazelnut praline platters traversing within 1.2m of Table 02, creating an unacceptable cross-contamination hazard.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Allergen airborne and touch transfer risk is severe within 2.5m of moving pastry platters.
Axiom 2: Ambassador Tariq requires designated certified Halal culinary runners.
Deduction 3: Moving Sophia Dubois to Table 01 (Diamond VIP - hypoallergenic zone) provides 6m physical buffer.
Synthesis 4: Table 02 runner route relocated to South Corridor, isolating all allergen vectors.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Eliminate all nut-based pastries from the entire 450-person menu (host objection).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Re-seat Sophia to Table 01 Hypoallergenic Sanctuary & establish 6m buffer zone.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Guarantees absolute medical safety for Sophia while honoring host culinary wishes.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Transfer Sophia Dubois to Table 01 Hypoallergenic Sanctuary
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Hypoallergenic buffer active; zero cross-contamination exposure path.

scenarios.title: Late Bar Surge & Decor Overspend Budget Squeeze
scenarios.premise: Late addition of imported champagne reserves ($3,800) threatens to pierce the $4,350 Contingency Reserve by 87%.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Unchecked beverage expansion depletes safety margin to $550, leaving the event vulnerable to overtime venue penalties.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Prudent fiscal governance requires maintaining at least $4,000 contingency buffer.
Axiom 2: Decor line item currently holds $6,450 for imported silk fabric drape rentals.
Deduction 3: Reallocating 2% ($1,300) from non-critical floral drapery into Contingency cushions the bar surge.
Synthesis 4: Net budget total remains strictly preserved at $65,000 with zero overdraft.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Cancel champagne upgrade and serve house sparkling wine (host preferred champagne).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Execute 2% non-destructive category reallocation from drape rentals to contingency.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Absorbs beverage surge while keeping overall budget strictly balanced at $65,000.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Non-Destructive Rebalance: Reallocate 2% to Contingency Reserve
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Contingency preserved at $4,350; category percentages balance to exactly 100%.

scenarios.title: Dual 13-Hour Continuous Shift Fatigue Risk
scenarios.premise: Marcus Sterling (AV Director) and Chef Antoine Laurent (Banquet Chef) are both rostered for 13 continuous hours without scheduled break coverage or handover.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Consecutive hours exceed occupational safety thresholds (12+ hrs), causing Shift Health to plunge to 57% and risking critical production misfires.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Continuous operations over 12 hours induce a 64% increase in human error rates.
Axiom 2: Marcus holds sole control of live 4K switching; Chef Antoine oversees 450 plated entrees.
Deduction 3: Scheduling Maya Lin as AV Deputy and Sous-Chef Bernard as Culinary Deputy creates mandatory 45-min relief windows.
Synthesis 4: Fatigue warnings cleared; Shift Health score surges from 57% to 92%.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Shorten banquet reception duration by 2 hours (violates client contract).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Appoint certified secondary deputies for 45-minute staggered handover rotations.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Guarantees uninterrupted operational excellence while protecting staff welfare.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Assign Staggered Deputy Handover & 45-Min Rest Windows
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Fatigue cleared for Marcus and Chef Antoine; Shift Health restored to 92%.

scenarios.title: Rain Ingress vs Valet Porte-Cochere Queue
scenarios.premise: Meteorological telemetry forecasts 45% probability of sudden evening squall between 20:30 and 22:00 during valet egress.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Single porte-cochere canopy can only shelter 12 guests simultaneously, creating queue congestion if 150+ guests request vehicles together.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Heavy rain will force all departing guests to congregate under the front canopy.
Axiom 2: Valet vehicle retrieval averages 4.5 minutes per ticket in wet pavement conditions.
Deduction 3: Deploying South Covered Gallery as secondary heated waiting lounge eliminates overcrowding.
Synthesis 4: Dispatches automated SMS vehicle readiness alerts to departing guests.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Hire 10 additional valet drivers (incurs $2,400 unbudgeted fee).
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Activate Covered South Gallery lounge and SMS dispatch staging.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Provides luxurious dry guest experience at zero incremental operational expenditure.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Deploy South Gallery Lounge & SMS Valet Notification
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Canopy bottleneck eliminated; guest departure experience rated 5-stars.

scenarios.title: Day 2 Ceremony Timeline Overlap with Orchestral Tuning
scenarios.premise: Live orchestra load-in on Day 2 is scheduled for 16:30, conflicting with the bridal party private pre-ceremony photography at 16:45.
scenarios.conflictIdentified: Brass and cello flight-case movement through South Transept disrupts private photography session.
chainOfThought: Axiom 1: Pre-ceremony photography requires undisturbed private access to South Transept architectural background.
Axiom 2: Orchestral instruments require 30 minutes acclimatization prior to rehearsal.
Deduction 3: Re-routing orchestra load-in through the North Freight Elevator bypasses photography zone entirely.
Synthesis 4: Both schedules proceed simultaneously with zero visual or physical collision.

tradeOffAnalysis.optionA: Shorten private photography session by 30 minutes.
tradeOffAnalysis.optionB: Enforce North Service Corridor routing for all orchestra equipment.
tradeOffAnalysis.rationale: Protects intimate host photography without compressing musical preparation.

scenarios.resolutionTitle: Reroute Orchestra Load-In via North Freight Elevator
scenarios.resolutionImpact: Full photo schedule preserved; orchestra staging complete 15 min early.
